title: Ask Spending with Apple Intelligence
description: In Ask Spending, you type text about your Apple Card transactions, for example "Dining this month vs last". WalletFeed shows a chart, a list and a summary.

title: Background Sync
description: Background Sync sends your Apple Card transactions to your destinations while WalletFeed is not open. Automations in Shortcuts can also send them.

title: Filter the transactions for a destination
description: A WalletFeed filter selects the Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions that a destination receives, by account, category, merchant or amount.

title: Destinations
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to an app, a spreadsheet or a file. You can add, change, stop and remove destinations.

title: Make a CSV file with Export CSV
description: Make a CSV file of your Apple Card transactions on your iPhone with Export CSV in WalletFeed. You select a period, then you save or send the file.

title: First steps with WalletFeed
description: Open WalletFeed on your iPhone for the first time and select the Wallet accounts that it can read. Then look at your Apple Card transactions.

title: WalletFeed User Guide
description: How to use WalletFeed on iPhone: Wallet accounts, Spending, Ask Spending, Search, Recurring Charges, destinations, Background Sync and WalletFeed Pro.

title: Privacy and security
description: This page about WalletFeed privacy and security tells you which data WalletFeed keeps and sends, and how to lock the app with Face ID.

title: Recurring Charges and alerts
description: WalletFeed finds the recurring charges on your Apple Card, such as subscriptions. It can send a notification for a new recurring charge or a price change.

title: Search
description: Find your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions with Search in WalletFeed. Type a merchant name or an amount, or use Apple Intelligence.

title: Send previous transactions
description: Send History sends your previous Apple Card transactions to a WalletFeed destination. Initial History sets the start date of new destinations.

title: Siri and Shortcuts
description: Use Siri and the Shortcuts app with WalletFeed on your iPhone to open Spending, find transactions and send Apple Card transactions to destinations.

title: Spending widget
description: Put the WalletFeed Spending widget on your iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen. It shows the This Month total and the Same Point Last Month total.

title: Spending
description: Spending in WalletFeed shows the total of your Apple Card and Apple Cash purchases this month. It also shows the totals by day, category and merchant.

title: Transactions
description: WalletFeed shows your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions on your iPhone. The list shows pending charges and refunds in month sections.

title: Troubleshooting
description: The steps on this page correct problems with WalletFeed, for example missing cards, "Authentication failed", "Sync Stopped" and copies of transactions.

title: Select the Wallet accounts that WalletFeed reads
description: Give WalletFeed access to your Apple Card, Apple Cash or Savings account on your iPhone. Change the accounts and their start dates in the Settings app.

title: WalletFeed Pro
description: WalletFeed Pro lets WalletFeed send your Apple Card transactions to destinations. This page gives the prices and tells you how to change or cancel a plan.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to your app or server
description: There is no web API for your Apple Card transactions. iPhone apps read them with FinanceKit. WalletFeed sends them to a webhook, AWS, Supabase or BankSync.

title: Put Apple Card transactions in an app that uses Plaid
description: You can connect your Apple Card to Plaid only in an iPhone app that reads Wallet. For a different app, use an export file from Wallet or WalletFeed.

title: Run a shortcut after each Apple Card purchase
description: Make a Shortcuts automation that sends each Apple Card purchase to your WalletFeed destinations seconds after you tap your iPhone.

title: See Apple Card spending by category
description: See your Apple Card spending by category on your iPhone, with the total for the month and the merchants. You can use Spending without WalletFeed Pro.

title: Add an Apple Card spending widget
description: Add an Apple Card spending widget to your iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen. It shows this month and the month before this month, to the same day and time.

title: Import Apple Card transactions into Actual Budget
description: You can import Apple Card transactions into Actual Budget. WalletFeed writes them to an OFX file each month, and you import the file on a computer.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Airtable
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to an Airtable base. Each transaction is a record.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to AWS
description: Send your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Amazon S3, SQS, Kinesis Data Streams, DynamoDB or EventBridge in your AWS account with WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to BankSync
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to a BankSync table. Your AI agents can read them with BankSync's MCP tools or REST API.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Coda
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a table in Coda (Superhuman Docs) with an API token.

title: Save Apple Card transactions to a CSV file automatically
description: WalletFeed writes your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to a CSV file in a folder that you select, and updates the file automatically.

title: Open Apple Card transactions in Excel
description: WalletFeed writes your Apple Card transactions to a CSV file on your iPhone. Excel opens the file on a Mac or a PC.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Firefly III
description: Send Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Firefly III. Make a personal access token in Firefly III. Then paste the token in WalletFeed.

title: Import Apple Card transactions into GnuCash
description: You can import your Apple Card transactions into GnuCash. On your iPhone, WalletFeed writes an OFX file for each month. Then, you import the files.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Google Sheets
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a Google Sheets spreadsheet in your Google Drive.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Linear
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Linear. Each transaction becomes an issue in a Linear team.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Lunch Money
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to Lunch Money. You paste a Lunch Money access token in WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Make
description: Send your Apple Card transactions to Make (the previous name of Make is Integromat). A Custom webhook receives each new or changed transaction.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Notion
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a Notion database. You can use the database for a budget.

title: Open Apple Card transactions in Numbers
description: Open your Apple Card transactions in a Numbers spreadsheet. WalletFeed saves them from your iPhone to a CSV file in iCloud Drive and updates the file.

title: Save Apple Card transactions as OFX files
description: WalletFeed saves your Apple Card transactions in one OFX file for each month and updates the files automatically. You import the files into your app.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to PocketSmith
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions to PocketSmith with no import file. You make a developer key in PocketSmith and paste it in WalletFeed.

title: Save Apple Card transactions as QIF files
description: WalletFeed saves your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone as QIF files. It writes one QIF file for each month to a folder that you select.

title: Upload Apple Card transactions to QuickBooks Online
description: Put your Apple Card transactions in QuickBooks Online with a file. WalletFeed saves them in OFX or CSV files, and you upload the files in QuickBooks.

title: Import Apple Card transactions into Quicken
description: You can import your Apple Card transactions into Quicken for Mac from OFX files that WalletFeed saves in iCloud Drive. Quicken for Windows uses a CSV file.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Supabase
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to a Postgres database in Supabase. Each transaction is one row in a table.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Sure
description: Send Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Sure, a self-hosted fork of Maybe Finance. Make an API key in Sure. Then paste the key in WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Toshl Finance
description: Send your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to Toshl Finance. Make a personal token in Toshl, then paste it into WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to a webhook
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a webhook in n8n or on your server.

title: Put Apple Card transactions in YNAB
description: You can put your Apple Card transactions in YNAB with the YNAB app for iPhone. WalletFeed can also save them in OFX or CSV files that YNAB imports.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Zapier
description: Send your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Zapier with WalletFeed. A Catch Hook trigger starts your Zap for each transaction and each change.

title: Make an export file of your Apple Card transactions
description: You can get an export file of your Apple Card transactions from Wallet, card.apple.com or WalletFeed. With WalletFeed Pro, WalletFeed also updates a file.

title: Find subscriptions on your Apple Card
description: Find the subscriptions and other recurring charges on your Apple Card in WalletFeed. Get a notification for a new recurring charge or a new price.

title: Guides
description: Step-by-step guides to send Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to budgeting apps, spreadsheets, files and automations with WalletFeed.

title: Search Apple Card transactions
description: Search in WalletFeed finds a purchase in your Apple Card transactions. You can type a merchant, an amount or a category, or use Apple Intelligence.
